name: Salt marsh
notes: Tidal grassland of salt-tolerant cordgrasses, rushes and succulent glasswort, zoned from the daily-flooded low marsh to a high marsh of salt hay, sea lavender and marsh elder; drawn on the US Atlantic/Gulf coast marshes and NW European (Wadden Sea, UK) saltings.
